policy: Required-if-applicable, never auto-certifies an implementation. Tiers: `core` controls are the release gate (check --release fails when an applicable core control has no verified proof); `reference` controls are advice and never block a release. `merged_from` lists old ids folded into a control; `retired` lists dropped ids with the reason. Profiles: desktop, lan, saas, paid, ai, regulated, sync, mesh, mobile, multi_site, multi_owner, windows. Connectivity tier cloud_sync activates sync and saas.

retired.reason: paperwork: the checkable parts are DATA-05 (restore on a clean PC) and OPS-01 (rollback)
process rule now enforced by GitHub branch protection (PR required, no force-push)
habit with no checkable outcome; HELP-07 and HELP-09 already fail when a guide or problem entry is missing
the gate has no outside-review step; consent (PRIV-01) and the never-collect limits (PRIV-03) are what the factory enforces
no separate regulated tier; retention, audit and encryption are covered by DATA-02, SEC-02, SEC-04 and the privacy limits PRIV-03
paperwork: `check` already requires buyer, problem and core_journey in the manifest
paperwork: `check` already requires core_journey and an acceptance scenario in the manifest
